scope: tail only; selected R1 body and gesture preserved

variants.title: 单束垂尾
variants.specific: TAIL OPTION T1: a single believable long horse tail with quiet weight and a slightly wind-lifted end. Narrow root about10-14mm wide, opens gently to20-25mm near the upper sweeping portion, then steadily narrows along the long descending path. Main fine tuft at bottom bends lightly toward right endpoint217,376. A very short secondary tuft can hint toward191,331, but it must not form another large blade or a deep V-shaped fork. Use only TWO main outer edges and ONE selected long hair-bundle separator if needed. Fine open or tapered tips, no sealed arrowhead. This should feel like hair hanging and gently being lifted, rather than a solid ribbon.
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. IMAGE 1 is the user's SELECTED R1 centaur drawing. IMAGE 2 is the fixed gold star geometry, for tail placement only. EDIT ONLY THE HORSE TAIL in image 1. User loves R1's angular body, face, hair, drawing arms, bow, arrow, torso, horse body and all four legs: preserve every one of those exactly, their positions, shape, detail, stroke weights and gesture. Keep same square boundary, same midnight-navy background, same size. Do NOT redesign the overall centaur, alter anatomy, move the legs, bow, hands or head. The current tail is too heavy and looks like a jointed flat sheet, a dragon tail, or an extra hoof at the bottom. Replace it with a clearly recognizable HORSE-HAIR TAIL emerging from ONE NARROW ROOT at the rear of the horse rump on the upper-left of its body. It flows LEFT-DOWN behind the rear legs, has natural hanging weight, angular yet elegant direction changes and gradually tapering long hair bundles. Use deliberate straight facets with enough small angle transitions for grace, not a sharp elbow or hard hinged polygon. Keep clear gaps between tail and rear legs/hooves. No broad leaf-like fins, no closed triangular paddle at tip, no internal giant triangles or cross-braces, no ornamental plume, no individual hair strand texture. Tail sides form soft thickness variation in long angular line segments, narrow at root, slightly fuller below the root, taper to slender tips. Follow the original gold-reference tail chain approximately: (84,165) at rump/root, (40,238) leftmost flow, (90,317) downward sweep, (140,386) bottom turn. The last two gold branch endpoints (191,331) and (217,376) are light terminal accents, not required to become two broad forks from the same junction. Keep white linework only, no gray/white filled areas or shading. All gold reference stars and lines are NOT part of output: NO gold dots, gold lines, added circles or text, no cyan guides. Exact gold graph will be applied later using project coordinates. Tail must stay inside square panel and not expand below the lowest reference point (y386 mm).

variants.title: 双束飘尾
variants.specific: TAIL OPTION T2: two gracefully separated HORSE HAIR BUNDLES, growing from a single narrow root, gradually spreading after the leftmost point(40,238). Separate the two bundles around(90,317), BEFORE the bottommost star, so they do not split from a single hard knot at(140,386). One lower long bundle descends to(140,386) and turns lightly toward217,376; the shorter upper bundle lifts gently toward191,331. Each bundle tapers continuously, slender pointed hair tufts rather than broad polygonal fins. Keep between them one broad dark breathing gap, no repeated parallel inner edges or narrow triangle lattice. Elegant wind-swept angular horse tail, lively but believable.

variants.title: 窄尾与星芒
variants.specific: TAIL OPTION T3: the LIGHTEST interpretation: one slender hair-tail outline follows the main tail reference chain, around12-20mm wide, and terminates cleanly around the bottom turn(140,386). Do NOT continue the white outline into two closed leaves or huge rightward forks. Let the two existing gold branch directions from the bottom point to191,331 and217,376 remain mostly OPEN negative space, with at most ONE short fine white taper stroke to suggest a few floating terminal hairs. The original gold graph will provide the celestial tail-tip sparkle later. One readable horse tail with sharp but graceful angular contour, low visual weight, a single clear fine tip. Avoid making it a rope or single stick.
